title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Hm… Hmm… Hmmm… Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?

title: Talk 1
original: This is a floral tea that I made myself, Doctor. Come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day.

title: Talk 2
original: The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfy. Even if I'm in charge here, it sometimes makes me want to sit down and relax for a bit.

title: Talk 3
original: Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget their sorrows and worries. That's probably a gardener's primary objective, don't you think?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I much prefer gardening to fighting. But as long as I think about how I'm helping everyone, I can muster up the courage to go into combat.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: These bottles? They're the pollen and seeds I've been collecting. I usually put on a gas mask and gloves before handling them, to protect me from poison.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Hm, everyone seems a bit weary these days. But, when they see the flowers I've planted, I'm sure they'll cheer right up.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? Everyone's been awfully busy the last few days… If nobody comes by the greenhouse, they're going to miss the blooming season. And wouldn't that be a terrible shame?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Tending the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as the flowers I grow can make people smile, all my hard work will be worth it!

title: Idle
original: Doctor? Oh, you're asleep… May the flowery fragrance waft over your dreams.

title: Onboard
original: Doctor, it's Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love for you to come by the greenhouse!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Oh… I was expecting a video about gardening.

title: Promotion 1
original: Artist? N-N-No, I'm not that talented. I'm just a normal gardener.

title: Promotion 2
original: Look, Doctor! These are the new varieties I've been tending for so long. They've finally started to bloom! Aren't they gorgeous?

title: Added to Squad
original: Hm? Am I going too?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Um, I've only ever tended a greenhouse. Can I really help with this…?

title: Depart
original: I see the enemy! Let's go!

title: Begin Operation
original: Everybody, look after yourselves!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Yes?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Where are we going?

title: Deployment 1
original: Got it.

title: Deployment 2
original: I'll do it.

title: In Battle 1
original: Careful, this pollen is allergenic.

title: In Battle 2
original: Okay, I'll handle this.

title: In Battle 3
original: I've seen weeds like these before.

title: In Battle 4
original: Let me protect everyone!

title: 4-star Result
original: Phew, are we safe already? Good job, everyone!

title: 3-star Result
original: Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Doctor, everyone is waiting for your next orders.

title: Operation Failure
original: Ah… I never thought it would turn out like this…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Should we plant some flowers over here?

title: Tap
original: Oh, Doctor?

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Back home, most flowers would already have withered by now. But just thinking about how spring will be here soon… fills my heart with hope. Doctor, let's find the first flower that blooms in the greenhouse together!

title: Greeting
original: Hello, Doctor!

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday! Please, try this floral tea! I made it the way Miss Lena taught me, and if you really savor it, you can taste a hint of cake flavor! Eh? You can't? Let me try… Oh… Sorry, Doctor. I… I think I forgot the honey…

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I've been all over with Rhodes Island. Does that mean I've spread flowery fragrance to just as many places? Hehe… I may still have lots of room for improvement, compared to Miss Lena, but I'll do my best to make Rhodes Island an even warmer place!
